title: "Sampling-to-first-report turnaround"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

- Turnaround: sampling to first report (earliest analysis date of the sample).

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: turnaround

samples <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
)

turnaround_values <- samples |>
  transmute(turnaround_days = as.numeric(analysis_date - sample_date)) |>
  filter(turnaround_days >= 0)

turnaround_summary <- tibble(
  n_samples = nrow(samples),
  n_valid_date_pairs = nrow(turnaround_values),
  n_excluded_missing_or_invalid = nrow(samples) - nrow(turnaround_values),
  median_days = median(turnaround_values$turnaround_days),
  q1_days = quantile(turnaround_values$turnaround_days, 0.25),
  q3_days = quantile(turnaround_values$turnaround_days, 0.75)
)

write_parquet(
  turnaround_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "turnaround-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  turnaround_values,
  file.path(results_dir, "turnaround-values.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: turnaround-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Sampling-to-report turnaround summary"
#| echo: false

kable(turnaround_summary)
```
